newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - $20 mln Brevard County SD, Fla..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - $20 mln Brevard County SD, Fla..

text.p: The School Board of Brevard County, Florida
Sealed proposals will be received by The School Board of Brevard County, Florida, in care of Kevin Conitz, William R. Hough & Co., 100 2nd Avenue South, Suite 800, St.
Petersburg, Florida 33701, (813) 895-8853, until 11:00 a.m., eastern time, on
for the purchase of all $20,000,000 Revenue Anticipation Notes, Series 1997, of The School Board of Brevard County, Florida (the

issued in fully-registered, book-entry-only form through a program qualified with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, as depository; to be dated May 8, 1997; to bear interest payable at maturity; and to mature May 8, 1998. The Notes will be special obligations of the Issuer, payable from and secured by (a) the proceeds of the ad valorem tax levy by the Issuer pursuant to Section

236.25(2), Florida Statutes, for its fiscal year ending June 30, 1998; and (b) amounts on deposit in the Sinking Fund for the Notes; and, if necessary, will be additionally payable from, but will not be secured by a lien upon or pledge of, all legally available funds of the Issuer derived from sources other than ad valorem taxation; the enforceability of all of which will be subject to bankruptcy laws and other laws affecting creditors' rights, and the exercise of judicial discretion. The Issuer shall furnish at its expense within 7 business days after the Notes have been awarded to the successful bidder, sufficient copies of the final Official Statement, which, in the judgement of the financial advisor to the Issuer, will permit the successful bidder to comply with applicable SEC and MSRB rules. The successful bidder will be furnished the legal opinion of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey L.L.P. at the expense of the Issuer. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement (deemed final'' (except for permitted omissions) by the Issuer in accordance with SEC Rule 15c2-12), Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form and other information may be obtained from B. Eugene Burkett, Associate Superintendent, Financial

Services, 2700 Judge Fran Jamieson Way, Viera, Florida 32940, (407) 633-1000, extension 600; or Kevin Conitz, William R. Hough & Co., 100 2nd Avenue South, Suite 800, St. Petersburg, Florida 33701, (813) 895-8853, financial advisor to the Issuer.
THE SCHOOL BOARD OF BREVARD COUNTY, FLORIDA
